plan.research_task: Analyze Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc (CMG) business model, market positioning, growth outlook, and strategic developments using the 10-K and earnings releases to assess competitive advantages and operational performance.
plan.financial_task: Evaluate annual XBRL facts, historical financial statements, and peer facts using available financial calculators to generate comprehensive valuation insights and quantitative metrics for CMG.

claims.claim: Chipotle operates restaurants featuring a menu of burritos, burrito bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads, and is committed to serving responsibly sourced, real food with no artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives under its Food with Integrity philosophy.
claims.quote: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc., a Delaware corporation, together with its subsidiaries (“Chipotle,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) owns and operates Chipotle Mexican Grill restaurants, which feature a relevant menu of burritos, burrito bowls (a burrito without the tortilla), quesadillas, tacos, and salads. We strive to cultivate a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients and without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.

claims.claim: As of December 31, 2025, Chipotle owned 3,938 restaurants in the U.S. and 104 international Chipotle restaurants, alongside 14 international partner-operated restaurants.
claims.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we owned 3,938 Chipotle restaurants throughout the United States (“U.S.”) and 104 international Chipotle restaurants. Additionally, we had 14 international partner-operated restaurants.

claims.claim: Digital sales represented 36.7% of total food and beverage revenue in fiscal year 2025.
claims.quote: Digital sales represented 36.7% of food and beverage revenue in 2025, compared to 35.1% in 2024.

claims.claim: Management expects to open approximately 350 to 370 new restaurants in 2026, including 10 to 15 international partner-operated restaurants, with around 80% of new company-owned restaurants featuring a Chipotlane.
claims.quote: We expect to open approximately 350 to 370 restaurants in 2026, which includes 10 to 15 international partner-operated restaurants. We expect around 80% of our new company-owned restaurants will include a Chipotlane.
